title: Kissed Russian Corn Flatbread
description: A resinous, aerated flatbread that soothes hangovers, featuring a corn arepa base filled with gooey mozzarella and a fragrant bhuna spice blend.
instructions: Combine corn flour and salt in a bowl, then whisk in warm water and olive oil until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2 minutes until elastic and let rest for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a thin circle about 10 cm in diameter.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat, then cook each flatbread for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Pack the mozzarella, bhuna spice blend, oregano, and cayenne pepper into a small bowl and mix until well combined.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly onto each cooked flatbread, then sprinkle with lemon zest.
Fold the flatbread into a pocket, sealing the edges with a fork or by pressing.
Return the filled pockets to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes, allowing the cheese to melt.
Remove from heat and serve immediately with a wedge of lemon.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
